objective: Bring Go to current committed Node feature parity, preserve provider extensibility and review open PR migration/security/cutover impact.

reference.additionalIntegratedFeature: PR #953 expiration emails and delivery history

requirements.requirement: Run the backend in Go, retaining the browser application and a Node rollback path
Preserve supported features and outputs of committed Node main, including billing/conferences, previews, preservation, notifications, submodules and review capabilities
Retain authentication, scopes, owner isolation, revocation, signed webhooks, safe redirects and bounded transformations
Retain streaming file/archive processing, cancellation, content verification and bounded cache/worker behavior
Allow additional providers through shared interfaces without rewriting lifecycle/content handlers
Review data/queue handoff and rollback needs without asserting a production rehearsal
Review open PRs for migration, security and cutover impact

deploymentSmoke.scope: Disposable MongoDB/Redis/storage, startup, non-root writes, static routes, graceful shutdown and rollback Compose model

collector.scope: Actual request, job, process and queue records through pinned Vector sanitizer; privacy and concurrency race tests

nodeRegression.limitation: The broad Node suite was not repeated after repairing its five failures; every failing case passed the targeted rerun. Optional external-service skips are not claimed as executed.

static.typescript: Passed directly and in freshly rebuilt Node rollback image

openPRs.ci: Open PR jobs could not start under the previously confirmed account billing block; local results provide validation. No CI-green claim.
openPRs.reviewThreads: 953-956 have no review threads. 957 has three unresolved/outdated threads; fixes were inspected in 88d696c/20621c0.

scopeAndLimits: Current Node means committed main 511dcd7, re-fetched during this audit. Uncommitted work in other checkouts was not modified.

Open PR #957 is a reviewed, unmerged feature rather than a current-main requirement. Its two new APIs and Redis/UI response changes must be ported together if adopted; its fixed four-streamer health rule is unsuitable for the Go deployment.
The optional Vector/VictoriaLogs/Grafana stack was reviewed and collector compatibility tested, not deployed.

Live Stripe test-mode checkout/webhooks, real Resend delivery, OAuth/App callbacks with copied data, and sanitized production restore/queue/rollback rehearsal remain deployment gates. Mocked protocol tests do not prove these live workflows.
No production or beta deployment, production data change, email delivery, PR merge or external provider adapter release was performed.
Earlier speed/memory reports are dated workload measurements. This audit makes no new production speedup or live memory claim.
intentionalDifferences: Preserve supported behavior without reintroducing Node bugs; unknown stored failures remain 500, explicit quota denials 402, and explicit credential/access errors retain their status.
Submodule ZIP entries use bounded per-file reads after the parent archive stream.
Owner notification history is conservatively rescanned at startup.
Stripe display prices and admin billing summaries are not cached.
No GitLab/Bitbucket implementation is shipped; the tested provider extension interface and documented credential obligations are supplied.

source.algorithm: Sorted backend-relative path, NUL, bytes, NUL; Go sources/tests, go.mod, go.sum and embedded logging policy.

fixes: Signal integration now reads the numeric JSON startup port instead of the removed text address field.
Unknown stored failures remain HTTP 500; only explicit permission failure codes map to HTTP 403.
correctedFailures.verification: All packages passed the subsequent full race/database run, including signal shutdown and repository recovery.

conclusion: Supported committed-main behavior, runtime migration and provider extensibility are verified under the documented no-bug-parity policy. Open PR migration/security/cutover impact is reviewed, including new unmerged #957. Production deployment and future unmerged feature ports are not represented as completed.
